label: R23 task A: modern registration/matching baselines on the V10 BF-SHG protocol (DEVELOPMENT; DEV only, no TEST)
authorization: User 2026-10-26 「都可以，你来接手，先做A和B」 (download of public pretrained weights approved).
question: Is the system-level BF-SHG SOTA claim (VCS-trained dense descriptors + host search vs CoMIR/MI/MIND) robust to current learned matchers and foundation features?
convention: methods.py: mov(R(theta)(z-c)+c+t) ~ ref(z), (y,x), c=(H-1)/2; error = host Q.corner_error_full (strict <9, loose <42 full-res px), plain mean over 320 rows = core macro (10 per core).
shared_domain: Every method searches |theta| <= 30 deg, |t| <= 51 px (host searcher domain); RANSAC hypotheses outside 1.05x that domain are rejected; globalign searches all whole-pixel shifts and angles in +-30 deg (its own exhaustive search).

methods.globalign: MIDA globalign: exhaustive FFT cross-MI (CMIF) over shifts x angle grid + refinement (Learn2Reg 2024 baseline)
methods.dinov2_host: Frozen DINOv2 patch tokens in the host energy (cosine) with the unchanged host searcher (DINO-Reg-style, training-free)

non_rotation_invariant: Rotation sweep of the moving image at the configured step over [-30, 30] deg; per angle: match -> map points back -> 2-point RANSAC rigid (tau 3 px at 512, 2000 iters, no scale) + LSQ refits; keep the angle hypothesis with most inliers (IWM Learn2Reg 2024 recipe).

configs.sparse_and_loftr (sp_lg, disk_lg, aliked: preproc {gray, log, inv, iwm} x rot_step {10, 5} = 8
configs.dense (roma, minima_roma): preproc {gray, log, inv, iwm} x rot_step {15, 10} = 8
configs.globalign: preproc {gray, log, iwm} x Q {8, 16} = 6 (61 angles over +-30, 32 refinement angles within +-1 deg, overlap 0.5)
configs.dinov2_host: arch {vits14, vitb14} x input scale {1, 2}; reference raw BF RGB, moving SHG intensity = 4

preproc: gray: BF luminance vs SHG intensity; log: BF luminance vs log1p SHG; inv: inverted BF luminance vs SHG; iwm: H&E hue channel + hist-eq + 5x5 median vs hist-eq + median SHG (Learn2Reg 2024 IWM). All uint8 by 0.5/99.5 percentile scaling.
selection_rule: Per method on CAL (80 problems): max loose success (<42), then max strict (<9), then min median err_full, then min mean seconds. Written to LOCK.json before any DEV run; one locked config per method on DEV.
dev_endpoints: strict <9, loose <42, median, p95 err_full over DEV32 x 10

paired core-level differences (core success rate, 32 cores, bootstrap 95% over cores, B=10000) vs V10 MF_VCS_M1, MLP_VCS_perm8, InfoNCE_host[J_perm1] (3-seed core means) and CoMIR_native (3 seeds); MI/NMI/MIND for context
limits: DEV is reused development data; this is not a TEST comparison
matchers run on the 512 host inputs (whole core at 4x down); full-resolution inputs are not part of this protocol
V10 learned methods were CAL-selected and trained on FIT; the matchers are pre-trained on natural images and only preprocessing / sweep step are selected on CAL (<= 8 configs each)
search non-determinism of V10 rows (0.6-2.2 pp re-evaluation noise) is not removed
